انتصروا (form VIII)
# اِنْتَصَرُوا (intaṣarū) /in.ta.sˤa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْتَصَرَ (intaṣara)
# اِنْتَصِرُوا (intaṣirū) /in.ta.sˤi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْتَصَرَ (intaṣara)
